report_metadata.assessment_framing: Confidential & Constructive Advisory DPIA Readiness Assessment
report_metadata.audit_scope: Publicly observable client-side DOM, HTTP response headers, pre-consent storage, network requests, and website automation signals (Read-Only Website Scope)

statutory_baseline.act: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (No. 22 of 2023; 9 Chapters, 44 Sections, 1 Schedule)
statutory_baseline.rules: Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025 (G.S.R. 846(E), notified 13 November 2025; 23 Rules, 7 Schedules)
statutory_baseline.enforcement_timeline: Phased: 13 Nov 2025 (Rules 1-2, 17-21); 13 Nov 2026 (Rule 4 Consent Manager registration); 13 May 2027 (Rules 3, 5-16, 22-23 operational compliance)
statutory_baseline.security_log_retention_minimum: Minimum 1 year (Rule 8(3) read with Seventh Schedule)

executive_readiness_summary.rule13_trigger_rationale: Observed 4 client-side automation/tracking integration(s) (including session replay, AI chat, CRM, or ad pixels) that process behavioural telemetry and warrant a formal Rule 13(2) algorithmic & software risk review.
key_observed_strengths: Grievance Redressal & 90-Day SLA (Sec 13 / Rule 14(3)): Grievance Officer / DPO text mention: true; Dedicated privacy/grievance emails found: None on landing page; 90-day SLA stated: true; Legacy 30/7-day SLA stated: false.
priority_readiness_enhancements: Notice & Transparency (Sec 5 / Rule 3): Publish a standalone, itemised Section 5 / Rule 3 Privacy Notice detailing personal data categories, specific purposes, DPO/Grievance contact, 90-day grievance SLA (Rule 14(3)), and English + Eighth Schedule language toggle.

Consent & Dark-Pattern Symmetry (Sec 6 / Rules 3-4): Remove all `checked` attributes from optional consent checkboxes, deploy a Section 6-aligned consent banner with equal-prominence `Accept` and `Reject Non-Essential` buttons, and expose a persistent footer trigger to withdraw consent with ease comparable to granting it.

Website Automations, AI & Profiling (Sec 6 / Rule 13(2)): Gate all marketing, CRM, session replay, and pixel automations behind affirmative consent categories; enforce strict DOM input masking (`data-clarity-mask`, `.fs-mask`) on session replay tools; and disable automatic form-field scraping prior to form submit.

Reasonable Security Safeguards (Sec 8(5) / Rule 6): Configure `Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload`, a strict `Content-Security-Policy`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin`, and retain server/access logs for a minimum of 1 year under Rule 8(3) and the Seventh Schedule.

Children's Data Protection (Sec 9 / Rules 10-11): If minor users are onboarded, implement a Rule 10 verifiable parental consent workflow (reliable identity/age token) and programmatically disable all behavioural analytics, session replay, and ad pixels for under-18 sessions (Section 9(3)).

Cross-Border Sub-Processors (Sec 16 / Rule 15): Maintain a live Sub-Processor & Cross-Border Transfer Register mapped to Section 8(2) Data Processing Agreements and Rule 15 transfer conditions; self-host static fonts and scripts where feasible.
executive_readiness_summary.board_advisory_synopsis: This confidential, read-only DPIA readiness assessment inspected razorpay.com against the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and the DPDP Rules, 2025 (G.S.R. 846(E)). The website achieved an advisory readiness score of 62/100 (Foundational Readiness (Priority Engineering Actions Recommended)), with 4 client-side automation/tracking signal(s) and 3 external sub-processor domain(s) catalogued for engineering and DPO review.

cdp_and_tag_managers.rule13_2_profiling_or_automated_risk_rel: Acts as a central fan-out router forwarding personal data and behavioural events to multiple downstream sub-processors.
cdp_and_tag_managers.advisory_governance_action: Enforce category-based destination filtering in Segment (`consent-manager`) and disclose downstream recipients under Rule 3.

cdp_and_tag_managers.rule13_2_profiling_or_automated_risk_rel: Dynamically injects third-party tracking scripts, pixels, and event listeners into the client DOM.
cdp_and_tag_managers.advisory_governance_action: Enable Google Consent Mode v2 (`ad_storage: "denied"`, `analytics_storage: "denied"`, `ad_user_data: "denied"`, `ad_personalization: "denied"` by default) prior to GTM initialization.

session_replay_and_heatmaps.rule13_2_profiling_or_automated_risk_rel: Records full DOM mutations, mouse movements, scroll depth, and rage clicks (high Rule 13(2) behavioural profiling sensitivity if unmasked).
session_replay_and_heatmaps.advisory_governance_action: Require explicit analytics consent before loading Clarity (`window.clarity("consent")`) and enforce strict DOM input masking (`data-clarity-mask="true"`).

ad_pixels_and_auto_advanced_matching.rule13_2_profiling_or_automated_risk_rel: Cross-site measurement, conversion attribution, and audience remarketing.
ad_pixels_and_auto_advanced_matching.advisory_governance_action: Implement Google Consent Mode v2 with default `denied` state and enable IP anonymization / redacted URL parameters.
